findings.finding: The existing constant-phi pass already propagates any single instruction/entry value through block-parameter cycles; it is not limited to integer literals. A new generic copy-phi pass would duplicate existing behavior.
findings.decision: Do not prioritize an unsupported assumption that loop-copy propagation is absent.

findings.finding: Nineteen actual query loops retain 48–51 instructions/six branches/no stack accesses on specified productive first-hit paths, versus IR65 55/six/zero and Rust 34/four/two.
findings.decision: Width cloning alone is insufficient; its measured median gain is small for 18-fold function growth.

findings.finding: Original fuel and terminal side exits occur after merging previous state at the loop header. Incoming-edge tests can return exact original header continuations while avoiding loop-carried cold snapshots.
findings.decision: Measure fuel-only placement, then productive-entry peeling independently; no gain assumed.

findings.finding: The pinned lowering source uses a generic scalar band rule and separate shift lowering. Exact generated paths still contain byte extension plus shift/mask rather than the short native bitfield forms seen in Rust.
findings.decision: Investigate a minimized IR reproducer and generic backend patterns; source inspection does not establish a speedup or prove the optimizer lacks every equivalent pattern.

findings.finding: Source-certified index/width addressing remains in Mech; Rust iterator code uses cursor-based traversal.
findings.decision: A bounded affine cursor/index representation with exact deoptimization remains a structural candidate.

findings.finding: Newer official Wasmtime release notes list AArch64 load common-subexpression and dead-store work.
findings.decision: A backend upgrade is a possible controlled experiment, not an assumed optimization.

techniques.name: Loop strength reduction, rotation and invariant specialization

scope: Read-only inspection of the exact pinned backend and exact-code artifacts. No dependency or power/security setting changed; unmeasured candidates have no assigned gains.
